description: The partial production the district made on 2027-01-08 in answer to the parent's records request. Two exports arrived: speech-language and occupational therapy. Nothing was produced for Specialized Academic Instruction or Individual Counseling, and no index or statement of what was withheld accompanied the bundle. The exports carry the defects real ones carry, injected on purpose: only HELD encounters appear, so every miss is invisible and can only be inferred from a gap in the date sequence; the same session note is copy-pasted across most rows; the whole set was bulk-certified on a single day at the end of the quarter, two weeks after the certifying provider's last day of employment; and the speech export records the 2026-11-12 encounter as a full 30 minutes when the provider's own email that afternoon said it ran about fifteen. The speech rows stop dead on 2026-12-03 with no row explaining why.
